senses.gloss:
(ऋ) देष्ट r. 1st cl. (देवते)
To sport or play.

m. (-वः)
1 A deity, a god.
2 A king, in poetical language.
3 A husband's brother: see देवृ.
4 A cloud.
5 A fool, a dolt.
6 A child.
7 A man following any particular line or business.
8 A spear-man, a lancer.
9 Emulation, wish to excel or overcome.
10 Sport, play.
11 A term or surname applicable to a Brahman; also to a man of the Kayeth class.
n. (-वं)
An organ of sense.
f. (-वा)
1 A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis).
2 A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.)
f. (-वी)
1 A goddess, the wife of any deity or divine being.
2 A name very commonly applied to the goddess DURGĀ.
3 A queen, one who has been consecrated as well as the king, (in theatrical language chiefly.)
4 A respectful epithet or title applied to a woman of the first class.
5 Worship, reverence.
6 A plant, (Trigonella corniculata.)
7 Another plant: see मूर्व्वा.
E.
दिव to play, (in heaven, &c.) affix अच्, fem. affix टाप् and ङीष्.

mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं)
1 Who or what sports or plays.
2 Divine, celestial, like a deity.
m. (-कः)
A proper name, the maternal grandfather of KṚṢṆA.
E.
दिव to play, ण्वुल् affix; or देव, and कन् aff.

m. (-मः)
A fragrant paste of sandal, agallochum, camphor, and safflower.
E.
देव, and कर्द्दम mud.

f. (-जा)
The mother of KṚṢṆA.
E.
देवक as above, and आत्मजा daughter.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Worship of, or oblations to the gods.
E.
देव, and कार्य्य business.

n. (-ष्ठं)
A kind of pine: (Pinus devadaru.)
E.
देव divine, and काष्ठ wood.

f. (-री)
One of the female personifications of the modes of music.

f. (-की)
DEVAKĪ, the daughter of DEVAKA, wife of VASUDEVA, and mother of KṚṢṆA.
E.
देवक, अञ् patronymick affix, fem. affix ङीष्; also with the vowel changed by the affix, दैवकी.

m. (-नः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
देवकी as above, and नन्दन a son.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Divine, belonging or relating to a divinity.
E.
देव, and छ aff.

m. (-नुः)
The deity KṚṢṆA.
E.
देवकी as above, and सूनु a son; also similar compounds, as देवकीनन्दन, and देवकीपुत्र.

n. (ण्डं)
A natural spring.
E.
देव, and कुण्ड a well.

n. (-लं)
A temple.
E.
देव a god, and कुल a house.

n. (-मं)
Cloves.
E.
देव a deity, and कुसुम a flower; fit for a deity.

mfn. (-तं)
1 A cave or hollow among mountains.
2 A natural pond or reservoir.
E.
देव a deity, and खात dug; not the work of men.

mn. (-कः-कं)
1 A natural pond or one in front of a temple.
2 A natural cavern, a grotto.
E.
देव a deity, खात dug, and कन् affix; dug by divine hands, or in honour of a god.

n. (-लं)
A cavern, a chasm.
E.
देवखात, and विल a hole.

f. (-री)
One of the Rāgiṇīs, or female personifications of the modes of music.

m. (-नः)
A Gandharba, a celestial quirister.
E.
देव a god, and गायन a singer.

f. (-री)
One of the female personifications of music.

m. (-रुः)
A name of VṚHASPATI.
E.
देव, and गुरु teacher; the preceptor of the gods.

n. (-हं)
1 A celestial or planetary sphere, the dwelling of the gods.
2 A temple.
E.
देब, and गृह house.

m. du. (-कौ)
The two sons of AŚVINĪ, and physicians of heaven.
E.
देव a god, and चिकित्सक a physician.

m. (-न्दः)
A garland or necklace of pearls, &c. composed of 100 or 103 strings.
E.
देव a deity, and छदि to cover, affix घञ्.

n. (-ग्धं)
A fragrant grass.
E.
देव a deity, and जग्ध eaten.

n. (-कं)
A fragrant grass.
E.
कन् pleonastic, added to the preceding.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
An artist, an artisan.
E.
दिव to sport, अटन् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-ट्टी)
A sort of gull, (Larus ridibundus.)

m. (-रुः)
The holy fig tree.
2 A tree of Svarga or paradise, the Mandāra tree.
3 The tree of plenty.
4 Any venerable and ancient tree; usually the place of assembling in a village.
E.
देव a deity, and तरु a tree.

f. (-ता)
1 A god, a deity or divine being.
2 Divinity: see देवत्व.
E.
देव divine, तल् affix of the abstract: in the first case, अन् added; of whom the attribute is divinity.

m. (-रः)
A temple.
E.
देवता, and आगार a house.

m. (-डः)
1 A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus.)
2 A name of Rāhu, the personified ascending node.
3 A name of fire.
4 A sort of creeper: see घोषक.
E.
देव a deity, &c. तड to torment, affix अण्.

m. (-कः)
A grass: see the preceding.
E.
कन् added to देवताड.

m. (-पः)
A name of INDRA.
E.
देवता a deity, अधिप ruler or chief.

n. (-नं)
Worshipping an idol.
E.
देवता, and अभ्यर्च्चन worshipping.

n. (-नं)
A temple.
E.
देवता, and आयतन dwelling.

n. (-र्थं)
The part of the hand sacred to the gods, the tips of the fingers.
E.
देव, and तीर्थ a shrine.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Divinity, the abstract attribute of divine being.
2 Identification with a deity, deification.
E.
देव a deity, and त्व abstract affix; also with तल्, देवता.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Given by the gods, god-given.
m. (-त्तः)
1 The younger brother of the legislator Buddha.
2 The conch of ARJUNA.
3 One of the vital airs, that which is exhaled in yawning.
E.
देव a deity, and दत्त given; the name is often used in grammatical and other examples, in the place of some one, a certain person, &c.

m. (-जः)
A name of Buddha.
E.
देवदत्त as above, and अग्रज elder born.

f. (-नी)
A sort of creeper, commonly Hātīghoṣa.
E.
देव a deity, and दान a gift, fem. affix ङीप्.

mn. (-रुः-रु)
A species of pine, (Pinus devadaru); in Bengal it is usually applied to the Uvaria longifolia, and in the Peninsula to another tree, (Erythroxylon sideroxylloides.)
E.
देव a deity, and दारु timber.

f. (-सी)
A courtezan, especially one employed as a dancer, &c. in a temple.
E.
देव a deity, and दासी a female slave.

m. (-पः)
An eye.
E.
देव an organ of sense, and दीप a lamp.

f. (-ती)
1 A female messenger of the gods.
2 A sort of plant; also मधुकुक्कुटी.
E.
देव, and दूती a messenger.

m. (-वः)
1 A name of BRAHMĀ.
2 A name of ŚIVA.
E.
देव god, repeated; god of gods.

f. (-णी)
The procession of a deity or idol.
E.
देव a deity, द्रुण to go, affixes घञ् and ङीप्.

mfn. (-द्र्यङ्-द्रीची-द्र्यक्)
Approaching or adoring a deity.
E.
देव an idol, अञ्च to go to or to worship, affix क्विप्, and द्रि inserted.

n. (-न्यं)
A sort of grain cultivated in many parts of Hindūstan, (Andropogon saccharatus.)
E.
देव a deity, and धान्य corn.

m. (-पः)
A fragrant resin, (Bdellium,) used in the incense.
E.
देव a deity, and धूप incense.

m. (-वा)
A husband's brother.
E.
दिव to play, अन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Sport, play, pastime, &c.
2 Emulation, desire to excel or overcome.
3 Affair, business, profession.
4 Gaming.
5 Splendour, lustre, beauty.
6 Light.
7 Praise.
8 Motion.
9 Grief, sorrow.
10 A garden, a play or pleasure ground.
11 A [] lotus.
m. (-नः)
A die or dice.
f. (-ना)
1 Service.
2 Sport, wanton sport or pastime.
E.
दिव to play, &c. affix ल्युट्, or युच्, fem. टाप्.

n. (-न्नं)
Rice or food that has been first presented to an idol.
E.
देव, and अन्न food.

m. (-न्दी)
One of INDRA'S doorkeepers.
E.
देव a deity, and नन्दिन् who pleases.

m. (-लः)
A kind of reed, (Arundo bengalensis.)
E.
देव, and नल a reed; also read देवानल.

m. (-कः)
A superhuman being.

m. (-यः)
A heaven, a paradise, the residence of a divinity.
E.
देव, and निकाय abode.

m. (-कः)
A heretic, an unbeliever, a reviler of the gods.
E.
देव, and निन्दक a calumniator.

f. (-न्दा)
Heresy, atheism.
E.
देव, and निन्दा abuse.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Natural, created.
E.
देव, and निर्म्मित made by.

m. (-तिः)
A name of INDRA.
E.
देव a deity, and पति master.

f. (-त्नी)
1 The wife of a deity.
2 Sweet potatoe.
E.
देव a deity, &c. and पत्नी wife.

m. (-थः)
Heaven, the firmament, the celestial path or way.
E.
देव a deity, and पथिन् a road, final affix अ.

n. (-दं)
The royal presence.
E.
देव, and पद for पाद a foot; also देवपाद.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Addicted to play.
2 Future, what will be, (predestined, &c.) see दैवपर.

m. (-शुः)
An animal consecrated to a deity.
E.
देव, and पशु an animal.

f. (-त्त्री)
A medicinal plant: see पृक्का.
E.
देव a deity, and पुत्त्री a daughter.

f. (-पुः)
The capital of INDRA.
E.
देव a god, and पुर् a city.

f. (-मा)
An idol.
E.
देव, and प्रतिमा image.

n. (-श्नं)
Astrology, consulting the stars or gods.
E.
देव a deity, and प्रश्न asking.

m. (-भः)
A tree used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria, Rox.) see युन्नाग.
E.
देव a deity, and बल्लभ a friend.

m. (-ह्मा)
A name of the Muni NĀRADA.
E.
देव a deity, ब्रह्मन् BRAHMĀ; BRAHMĀ amongst the saints and demigods.

m. (-णः)
A venerable Brahman, one esteemed by the deities.
E.
देव, and ब्राह्मण a Brahman.

n. (-नं)
1 The holy fig tree.
2 Paradise.
3 A temple.
E.
देव a deity, and भवन a dwelling.

mfn. (-क् or ग्)
Belonging to a god.
E.
देव, and भाज् what has.

m. (-भूः)
1 A deity.
2 Svarga or paradise.
E.
देव divine, and भू being.

f. (-तिः)
The Ganges of heaven.
E.
देव a deity, and भूति being, abiding.

n. (-यं)
1 Divinity, godhead.
2 Inferior deification or identification with a deity.
E.
देव a deity, and भूय being, becoming.

n. (-रं)
The jewel of KṚṢṆA suspended on his breast.

m. (-णिः)
1 A name of ŚIVA.
2 The jewel of KṚṢṆA.
3 A twist of hair on a horse's neck.
E.
देव a deity, मणि a jewel.

f. (-ता)
A name of ADITI.
E.
दव, and मातृ a mother; the mother of gods.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Watered by rain, (corn, land, &c.)
E.
देव a cloud, मातृ a mother, and कप् affix; cherished by the clouds as by a parent.

m. (-कः)
The jewel worn by KṚṢṆA: see कौस्तुभ.
E.
देव a deity, मान respect, affix कन्.

m. (-सः)
The eighth month of pregnancy; also देवमासक.
E.
देव divine, and मास a month.

m. (-यक्)
A worshipper of the gods.
E.
देव, and यज् to worship, क्विप् aff.

m. (-जिः)
1 A worshipper of the gods.
2 A Muni.
E.
देव, and यजि who worships.

m. (-ज्ञः)
The Homa or burnt sacrifice.
E.
देव, and यज्ञ sacrifice; the sacrifice appropriated to the gods.

f. (-त्रा)
The procession of a deity or idol, or sacred festival when the images are carried in procession.
E.
देव a god, and यात्रा going.

n. (-नं)
The car or vehicle of a god.
f. (-नी)
The daughter of ŚUKRA.
E.
देव a deity, and यान going.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Sporting, playing.
E.
देव to play, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-युः-युः-यु)
1 Pious, righteous, virtuous.
2 Frequenting holy festivals.
m. (-युः)
A deity.
E.
देव a deity, या to go, Uṇādi affix कु.

m. (-निः)
A superhuman being, a demon or demigod.
E.
देव a deity, and योनि place of production.

m. (-रः)
A husband's brother, especially his younger brother.
E.
दिव to play, &c. affix अर.

m. (-थः)
The car or vehicle of a deity.
E.
देव a deity, and रथ a carriage.

m. (-जः)
INDRA.
E.
देव a deity, राजन् a king, and टच् aff.

m. (-तः)
1 A sort of crane.
2 The name of a king; also Parikṣit.

mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि)
Godlike, of divine form.
E.
देव, and रूप form, इनि aff.

m. (-र्षिः)
A Ṛṣi, a saint of the celestial class, as NĀRADA, ATRI, MARĪCĪ, BHARADVĀJA, PULASTYA, PULAHA, KRATU, BHṚGU, VASIṢṬHA, PRACETAS; also BHĀRATA, TUMBURU, KAṆĀDA, and others.
E.
देव divine, and ऋषि a saint: see ऋषि, and राजर्षि.

m. (-लः)
1 An attendant upon an idol; a Brahman of an inferior order, who subsists upon the offerings made to the images which he attends, and who conducts the ceremonies of all sorts of people for hire.
2 A Muni; according to some authorities, a name of NĀRADA; to others, of a different saint, who is also a legislator, the son of ASITA and also named AṢṬAVAKRA.
3 A husband's brother: see देवर.
4 A holy or virtuous man.
E.
देव a deity, ला to bring, and क aff.

f. (-ला)
One of the female personifications of music.
E.
देव a deity, and अल adapted to, fem. affix टाप्.

m. (-कः)
The attendant on an idol: see the preceding.
E.
कन् added to देवल.

f. (-ता)
Double jasmine.
E.
देव divine, and लता a creeper.

m. (-कः)
1 Heaven or paradise.
2 Any one of the seven superior worlds, from earth to the highest or Satya loka, in [] opposition to those below the earth.
3 The particular sphere or heaven of any divinity.
E.
देव, and लोक a world.

m. (-क्त्रः)
Fire or its deity AGNI.
E.
देव a deity, and वक्त्र a face, here implying, mouth; the mouth of the gods, eating or consuming the oblations made to them.

m. (-भः)
A tree: see पुन्नाग.

m. (-रः)
A superior or supreme deity.
n. (-रं)
A divine boon or blessing.
E.
देव, and वर best.

m. (-किः)
A name of VIŚVAKARMĀ, the divine architect.
E.
देव a deity, वर्द्धकि a carpenter.

m. (-क्षः)
1 A tree, (Echites scholaris.)
2 A tree of heaven or paradise.
3 A plant yielding a fragrant resin, (Bdellium.)
E.
देव a god, वृक्ष a tree.

m. (-तः)
1 A worshipper of the gods.
2 A name of BHĪṢMA.
n. (-तं)
Any obligation or vow of a deity.
E.
देव a deity, and व्रत religious obligation.

m. (-तः)
1 A god.
2 A sacred treatise or branch of scripture.
3 A name of NĀRADA.
E.
देव divine, and श्रुत heard.

f. (-भा)
An assembly of the gods.
E.
देव a deity, and सभा assembly.

m. (-भ्यः)
1 A player, a gambler, a frequenter of clubs or assemblies.
2 An attendant on a deity.
E.
देव sport in general, or gambling, सभा an assembly, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Divine, relating to a deity.
E.
देव, and सन्ध connected.

f. (-हा)
A small shrub: see सहदेवा.
E.
देव a deity, सह to bear, affix टाप् and अञ्.

ind.
In or on a deity, becoming as a deity, appropriate or offered to one.
E.
देव, and साति aff.

n. (-ज्यं)
1 Inferior deification, the state or being of the inferior gods.
2 Absorption into or identification with a deity.
E.
देव a god, स with युज to join or be joined, affix क्विप्, देवसयुज् junction with a deity, ष्यञ् added, implying the state or condition.

f. (-ष्टा)
Spirituous liquor.
E.
देव, and सृष्ट created, made by the gods.

f. (-ना)
1 The daughter of INDRA.
2 An army or host of celestials.
E.
देव INDRA or any deity, and सेना an army.

m. (-तिः)
A name of SKANDA.
E.
देवसेना as above, and पति ruler; commander of the hosts of heaven.

n. (-स्वं)
The property applicable to religious purposes, endowments, &c.
E.
देव divine, and स्व wealth.

m. (-श्वः)
The horse of INDRA.
E.
देव a deity, and अश्व a horse.

m. (-वः)
An attendant upon an idol, a low Brahman, subsisting by attendance upon an image, and upon the offerings made to it.
E.
देव a deity, and आजीव who gets a livelihood; also with इनि added देवजीविन् m. (-वी.)

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
1 One with or identified with a deity.
2 Belonging to a deity, consecrated, sacred.
m. (-त्मा)
The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)
E.
देव, and आत्मन् the self or soul.

m. (-यः)
1 A goat.
2 An ascetic, one who relinquishes or abandons the world.
3 A fool, an ideot.
E.
देव in the second case plural, and प्रिय beloved; the beloved of the gods.

m. (-पिः)
The son of PRATĪPA, supposed to be still alive, near the Sumeru mountain.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Sacred, dedicated to a deity.
f. (-ष्टा)
Betel, (Piper betel.)
E.
देव, and अभीष्ट wished.

n. (-नं)
A temple.
E.
देव, and आयतन abode.

n. (-धं)
The rainbow.
E.
देव, and आयुध a weapon.

n. (-यं)
1 A division of heaven, the residence of the gods.
2 A temple.
E.
देव and आलय an asylum.

mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-हं)
Divine, worthy of the gods.
E.
देव, and अर्ह fit for.

m. (-सः)
1 A temple.
2 The holy fig tree.
E.
देव a deity, and आवास abode.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Appertaining to or derived from a deity.
E.
देव, and ठच् affix; also देविय, and देविल.

f. (-का)
The name of a river, the Sarju or Deva.
E.
देवी, and कन् affix, fem. form.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Virtuous, pious, just.
2 Appertaining to a deity: see देविक.
E.
देव, and इलच् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-वी)
See देव.

m. (-ट्टः)
A town, the city of VĀṆA, probably DEVICOTTA, on the Coromandel coast.
E.
देवी a name of DURGĀ, and कोट्ट a house or abode.

m. (-वा)
1 A husband's brother, but especially his younger brother.
2 The husband of a woman previously married.
E.
दिव to play, Uṇādi affix ऋण्.

m. (-ज्यः)
A name of VṚHASPATI.
E.
देव a deity, and इज्य a teacher, the Guru or spiritual preceptor of the gods.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Acceptable to the gods, wished for by them.
E.
देव, and इष्ट wished.

n. (-नं)
A sacred grove, one near a temple or consecrated to a deity.
E.
देव a deity, and उद्यान a garden.
